name: Usaneko ~Mimikko Meido no Ongaeshi~
original_name: うさねこ ～みみっ娘メイドの恩返し～
source:
Yuuya, your classic Japanese Student Living Alone, assists a cat and a rabbit in their moment of need, and two days later he receives a visit from two beautiful maids sporting cat and rabbit ears and offering their free services for two months.
Admit it, you already know the rest...

[Adapted from a [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4143]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
悠也是個再普通不過的日本學生，一個人住。某次貓和兔子陷入困境時，他出手相助。兩天後，兩名分別長著貓耳和兔耳的美麗女僕登門拜訪，表示願意免費為他服務兩個月。
承認吧，接下來會發生什麼，你早就猜到了……

[改編自Baldo發布的一篇[url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4143]論壇文章[/url]]
